title: Power Stack Watchlist
method: Action-oriented queue combining thesis quality, current price location and technical confirmation. Candidate Power Stack scores are not the same as the fundamentals-only holding scores.

buckets.label: Buy / Accumulate
buckets.description: Price and thesis are aligned enough for staged entry.

buckets.label: Selective / Retest
buckets.description: Good business or theme, but entry quality needs a better level or confirmation.

buckets.label: Wait / Confirm
buckets.description: Interesting exposure, but current risk/reward is not strong enough to force.

buckets.label: Avoid / High Risk
buckets.description: Theme may be attractive, but company, dilution or earnings risk currently dominates.

candidates.name: Xylem Inc.
candidates.thesis: Orders, margins and guidance are strengthening while the chart is testing long-term rising support. Adds a non-semiconductor route into the physical AI bottleneck.

candidates.name: CGN Power Co., Ltd.
candidates.thesis: Profitable operating reactor fleet plus a large construction pipeline gives cleaner nuclear exposure than pre-revenue SMR optionality.

candidates.name: Quanta Services, Inc.
candidates.invalidation: Reassess on sustained break below ~$580–600 support region
candidates.thesis: Backlog and earnings continue to validate the grid bottleneck thesis. The correction has improved the entry without damaging the core business case.

candidates.name: Tenaga Nasional Berhad
candidates.theme: Malaysia power · data centres · regulated grid
candidates.thesis: Headline earnings weakness is more severe than the underlying core deterioration. Data-centre electricity demand and regulated grid capex remain the larger structural drivers.

candidates.name: Ford Motor Company
candidates.thesis: Raised guidance plus a technically important rising support area creates a more asymmetric value setup than the headline auto narrative suggests.

candidates.name: Modine Manufacturing Company
candidates.confirmation: Sustained trade back above the 4H mean
candidates.invalidation: Fresh structural low with no earnings deterioration explanation
candidates.thesis: Data-centre revenue growth is already visible in reported results. The business thesis is strong; the chart still needs either a cheaper entry or trend confirmation.

candidates.name: McDonald's Corporation
candidates.thesis: Interesting because the stock has reset into structural demand, not because high beef prices are bullish. Beef inflation is an input-cost risk while lower-income traffic remains the key operating watch.

candidates.name: Halliburton Company
candidates.invalidation: Failure back through recent higher-low structure
candidates.thesis: Sequential North America and international improvement is constructive, but the chart is pressing resistance rather than offering a clean low-risk entry.

candidates.name: Chevron Corporation
candidates.invalidation: No thesis break; entry risk is the issue
candidates.thesis: Fundamentals and post-Hess scale are strong, but the stock has already rerated sharply into resistance. Better business than current entry.

candidates.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp.
candidates.invalidation: Loss of IPO-price support without a new catalyst
candidates.theme: Space · launch · satellite infrastructure · orbital AI
candidates.thesis: Extraordinary strategic assets, but the public valuation already discounts huge future scale and capital requirements remain enormous. Avoid treating SpaceX quality as equivalent to cheap SpaceX equity.

candidates.name: China Resources Power Holdings Co., Ltd.
candidates.invalidation: Break of long-term rising triangle support
candidates.thesis: Utility quality is acceptable, but recent earnings and renewable-profit momentum are weaker than CGN Power. Not the best China-power expression at current price.

candidates.name: Enphase Energy, Inc.
candidates.thesis: Technical compression is interesting, but weak revenue guidance and tariff pressure mean the business has not earned a high-conviction reversal call yet.

candidates.name: NuScale Power Corporation
candidates.confirmation: Base + higher high after dilution overhang
candidates.thesis: Nuclear theme remains strong, but equity dilution and project-commercialisation risk make this a weaker vehicle than operating nuclear utilities at present.

candidates.name: Xinyi Solar Holdings Ltd.
candidates.theme: Solar glass · China solar supply chain
candidates.thesis: The chart is cheap-looking because industry oversupply has crushed profitability. Technical support alone is not enough while the earnings base is still impaired.
